verdict.rationale: Several Token2 companion tools (desktop/mobile FIDO2 management apps, fido2-manage) are explicitly described as open-source with public GitHub repos, letting an AI-native user read that source code. However, no explicit license file/type is cited, and the core hardware/firmware product itself is not claimed to be open source. missing for 10: explicit license identification (e.g., MIT/Apache), confirmation that core product (not just companion tools) is open source.
